name: Cervelló (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the dark blue stag of the arms.
history: The new flag was approved on 14 May 2018 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 7622 of 18 May 2018; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with the dark blue stag of the arms at the centre.

features.role: stag of the arms, 2/6 of the height
